title: General requirement for investments.
bodyText: A savings and loan association shall make investments that are consistent with prudent banking practices and in compliance with all applicable federal and state law.
bodyHtml: §412:7-305  General requirement for investments.  A savings and loan association shall make investments that are consistent with prudent banking practices and in compliance with all applicable federal and state law. [L 1993, c 350, pt of §1]
